newsitem.title: USA: U.S. welcomes new French foreign minister.
newsitem.headline: U.S. welcomes new French foreign minister.

text.p: The U.S. State Department on Thursday welcomed the appointment of Hubert Vedrine as foreign minister in France's new Socialist government.
Spokesman Nicholas Burns said Vedrine was "a person well known to us" as one-time chief of staff to late French President Francois Mitterrand.
Secretary of State Madeleine Albright planned to telephone or write to Vedrine later in the day, Burns told reporters.
"She looks forward to working with M. Vedrine, and with Prime Minister (Lionel) Jospin, as well as with President (Jacques) Chirac," he said.
